✨ Furnished Yaletown Condo | 2 Bed, 2 Bath | $4,200/Month All-In

Move in November 8 with nothing but a suitcase. This fully furnished 2-bed, 2-bath sits in the heart of Yaletown, a short walk from David Lam Park and the seawall, and the price covers everything. Utilities and high-speed internet included, no surprises on top.

1,100 sq ft with in-suite laundry and a private balcony 21 floors up, with the views that come with the height. Furnished throughout, so there’s nothing to buy or move in.

🏋️ Building perks: fitness centre, pool, hot tub, and sauna
📍 Steps from groceries, dining, and the Canada Line

Terms:
• Available November 8 through mid-January (flexible)
• No pets, no smoking
• Security deposit required
• Quick pre-screening, then viewing by appointment
